AP_ITEM_RELIC_MODEL.title: Archipelago Check
AP_ITEM_RELIC_MODEL.description: It is a check whatcha expecting
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.title: Relic Coupons
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.descript: Earn Relic Coupons from Elites and Chests. Coupons pair with Archipelago Relic items, granting relics through natural rewards or the Archipelago Rewards menu. A negative counter means you need to defeat more Elites or find more eligible relic rewards; a positive counter means you need to receive more AP Relic items.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.flavor: A promise that somewhere in the multiworld, a relic is waiting for you.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AGED_CHEESE.title: Aged Cheese
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AGED_CHEESE.descriptio: After defeating an Elite or a boss, raise your Max HP by 3.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AGED_CHEESE.flavor: Now that you can see your health, you can see it growing.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_FROZEN_EYE.title: Frozen Eye
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_FROZEN_EYE.descript: The draw pile shows cards in the order you will draw them. The first time you shuffle your draw pile each turn, draw 1 more card next turn.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_FROZEN_EYE.flavor: Now that you can see your piles, you can see what comes next.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_WAYFINDER.title: Wayfinder
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_WAYFINDER.descripti: Three times per run, you may travel to any room in the next row, ignoring the paths. Shares its moves with Winged Boots and Route Diagram: each move uses up only one of them.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_WAYFINDER.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_SECOND_WIND.title: Second Wind
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_SECOND_WIND.descrip: Once per run, when you would die, survive and heal 35% of your Max HP.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_SECOND_WIND.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_ROUTE_DIAGRAM.title: Route Diagram
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_ROUTE_DIAGRAM.descr: Once per act, you may travel to any room in the next row, ignoring the paths. Shares its move with Winged Boots and Wayfinder, and is used first.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_ROUTE_DIAGRAM.flavo: Now that you can see the map, you can see a way through it.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_INK_BOTTLE.title: Ink Bottle
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_INK_BOTTLE.descript: Every time you play 10 cards, draw 1 card.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_INK_BOTTLE.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_MEDICAL_KIT.title: Medical Kit
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_MEDICAL_KIT.descrip: Status cards can be played for 0 energy. Playing a Status card Exhausts it.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_MEDICAL_KIT.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_BLUE_CANDLE.title: Blue Candle
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_BLUE_CANDLE.descrip: Curse cards can be played for 0 energy. Playing a Curse makes you lose 1 HP and Exhausts it.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_BLUE_CANDLE.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_PRESERVED_INSECT.de: Enemies in Elite fights have 25% less HP.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_PRESERVED_INSECT.fl: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_TORII.title: Torii
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_TORII.description: Whenever you would receive 5 or less unblocked attack damage, reduce it to 1.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_TORII.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_TURNIP.title: Turnip
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_TURNIP.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_AMPHORAE.title: Amphorae
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_AMPHORAE.descriptio: At the start of each act, fill all empty potion slots with random potions.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_AMPHORAE.flavor: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_CURSED_KETTLE.title: Cursed Kettle
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_CURSED_KETTLE.descr: The first time you draw a Curse each turn, draw 1 card.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_AP_CURSED_KETTLE.flavo: A Boon from your Archipelago settings.
